versions.changelog:
Initial release supporting batch health inspection for Alibaba Cloud RDS PostgreSQL instances.

- Supports inspection of single, multiple, or all RDS PostgreSQL instances with configurable time window (default 7 days, up to 30 days).
- Automatically produces HTML reports for each instance and a summary HTML report (in global mode).
- Analyzes instance basics, resource utilization, alert history, slow queries, long transactions, table bloat, QPS/TPS, and replication delay.
- Auto-detects cluster instances and aggregates per-node metrics.
- Recognizes natural language triggers in both English and Chinese for flexible inspection requests.
- Strictly runs the batch script for inspection; no manual composition or deliverable fabrication required.
